path.description: Path of the cjpm.toml file (relative to the configuration file), for example, ./cjpm.toml.

abiFilters.description: Defines the CPU architecture type of the system where the Cangjie application runs. Multiple CPU architecture types can be included, for example, Arm64-v8a.

strictCheckDependencies.description: A build error is reported when a dependency is not installed.

arguments.description: Specifies cjpm compilation parameters, for example, --cfg

collectSDKLibs.description: Package the runtime libraries, system libraries, and standard libraries used by the application.

checkDeviceTypes.description: Check whether the configured deviceTypes is verified.
